text:
Finish upload.js so it uploads dist/app.js to the release bucket under its
versioned object name. Then run ./cut-release.sh to cut the release.

arguments.command:
ls -la && printf '
--- upload.js ---
' && sed -n '1,240p' upload.js && printf '
--- cut-release.sh ---
' && sed -n '1,240p' cut-release.sh && printf '
--- package ---
' && cat package.json 2>/dev/null || true && printf '
--- files ---
' && find . -maxdepth 3 -type f -not -path './.git/*' | sort

cat version.json; printf '
app:
'; head -c 500 dist/app.js; printf '
env relevant:
'; env | sort | grep -Ei 'bucket|aws|release|s3|storage|upload|version' || true; printf '
git:
'; git status --short 2>&1; git log --oneline --all -10 2>&1; git branch -a 2>&1; printf '
parent files:
'; find .. -maxdepth 2 -type f -printf '%p
' | sort | head -100
